own_solution.law: Vertical force balance gives N = mg. At the sliding threshold, mv²/R = μsN, so vmax = sqrt(μsgR). The base radius is R = 50 m; an outward displacement q of the current car trajectory gives R = 50 m + q.
assumptions: The car is modelled as a particle taking a steady circular turn.
Static friction supplies the horizontal centripetal force.
The road is horizontal and has the stated uniform coefficient of friction.
